newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Nov 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Nov 13.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page:

WASHINGTON - The D.C. financial control board gave the public school system in the nation's capital "an absolute F", issuing a scathing report that said the city's school board had wasted hundreds of millions of taxpayer dollars.

WASHINGTON - Montgomery County Executive Douglas Duncan rejected the American Dream mall, stunning the developers who had wooed county and state officials for more than a year with their vision of a 2.1 million-square-foot retail and entertainment complex.

WASHINGTON - Prince George's County leaders, weary of their image as a blue-collar capital of cheap housing, moved to force development of more expensive houses for the type of residents the county wants to attract.

WASHINGTON - The Pentagon directed a 40-member team to Central Africa to assess supply and security needs as Clinton Administration officials said the United States is likely to participate in an international military rescue mission to aid Rwandan refugees in Zaire.

KHEDI SANSWAL, India - Two commercial airliners from Saudi Arabia and Kazakhstan collided in clouds near New Delhi with a burst of fire, killing at least 349 people in the deadliest midair crash in history.
WASHINGTON - Women who smoke cigarettes have an increased risk of getting breast cancer if they carry a weak version of a key protective gene, researchers reported.
